name: Question 8
problem:
$$
A=[\begin{aligned}-8 & 5 & -3 & 2 \\ 2 & 4 & 6 & -1 \\ 6 & 1 & -1 & 2 \\ -10 & -3 & -7 & 4\end{aligned}],\,B=[\begin{aligned}-4 & 13 & 9 & 0 \\ 2 & 4 & 6 & -1 \\ 10 & 9 & 11 & 0 \\ -2 & 13 & 17 & 0\end{aligned}]
$$

Consider the matrices $A$ and $B$ above. By applying three matrix elementary row operations 

- ${R}_{1}:=…$
- ${R}_{3}:=…$
- ${R}_{4}:={R}_{4}+4{R}_{2}$

each of the form ${R}_{i}:={R}_{i}+k{R}_{2},$ the matrix $A$ can be transformed into the matrix $B.$ What are the missing elementary row operations?

Question 8
?

A=[−85−32246−161−12−10−3−74],B=[−41390246−1109110−213170]

Consider the matrices A and B above. By applying three matrix elementary row operations

  1. R1:=…
  2. R3:=…
  3. R4:=R4+4R2
each of the form Ri:=Ri+kR2, the matrix A can be transformed into the matrix B. What are the missing elementary row operations?

a
R1:=R1+R2 and R3:=R3+R2
b
R1:=R1+2R2 and R3:=R3+2R2
c
R1:=R1−2R2 and R3:=R3+2R2
d
R1:=R1−2R2 and R3:=R3−2R2
e
R1:=R1+2R2 and R3:=R3−2R2
Submit
